title: CABS+: Efficient and Scalable Model Merging via Conflict-Aware Sparsification and Adaptive Weight Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2608.12842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model merging has recently attracted significant attention as a promising paradigm for constructing unified multi-task models without requiring additional retraining. However, parameter conflicts and knowledge interference across tasks often degrade merged-model performance. Prior work introduced Conflict-Aware and Balanced Sparsification (CABS), which reduces parameter interference through structured pruning and sequential masking. However, CABS relies on grid search to determine scaling coefficients, resulting in exponential time complexity, while its optimization objective can be dominated by high-performance tasks, leading to suboptimal overall performance. To address these limitations, we extend CABS and propose CABS+. Specifically, Adaptive Weight Allocation (AWA) optimizes merging coefficients via a gradient-free search scheme to reduce time complexity, while an asymmetric fitness function promotes more comprehensive performance g

translated_title: CABS+：通过冲突感知稀疏化与自适应权重分配实现高效可扩展的模型合并
translated_abstract: 模型合并近来作为一种有前景的范式引起了广泛关注，它无需额外重训练即可构建统一的多任务模型。然而，跨任务的参数冲突和知识干扰常常降低合并模型的性能。先前的工作引入了冲突感知与平衡稀疏化（CABS），通过结构化剪枝和顺序掩码减少参数干扰。然而，CABS依赖网格搜索来确定缩放系数，导致指数级时间复杂度，同时其优化目标可能被高性能任务主导，导致整体性能次优。为解决这些限制，我们扩展了CABS并提出CABS+。具体而言，自适应权重分配（AWA）通过无梯度搜索方案优化合并系数以降低时间复杂度，而不对称适应度函数则促进更全面的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出CABS+方法，通过无梯度自适应权重分配和不对称适应度函数，解决了CABS在模型合并中时间复杂度高和优化目标被主导的问题，实现了更高效、更可扩展且整体性能更优的模型合并。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CABS+, which addresses CABS's high time complexity and optimization dominance issues in model merging via gradient-free adaptive weight allocation and an asymmetric fitness function, achieving more efficient, scalable, and better overall performance.
